list_voices.title: List voices
list_voices.description: List the text-to-speech voices available, each with its voice_id, name and language, optionally filtered to one language. This endpoint is limited to 20 calls a day, so store the result and reuse it.

language_code.description: Only voices for this language, e.g. en-US.

create_audio.title: Create audio from text
create_audio.description: Convert one or more pieces of text to speech and get the audio back base64-encoded. voice_ids and texts are parallel lists: the first voice reads the first text, and so on, so several voices can be combined in one clip. The optional pitch, rate and volume lists follow the same order. Uses character credits.

voice_ids.description: Voice id for each text, from list_voices.

texts.description: The text for each voice to speak, in the same order as voice_ids.

pitch_rates.description: Pitch adjustment per text, -50 to 50, or 'default'.

speaking_rates.description: Speaking rate per text, 20 to 200, or 'default'.

volumes.description: Volume adjustment per text, -40 to 40, or 'default'.

output.description: The result with the base64-encoded audio.

transcribe_text_v1.title: Create audio from text (v1 API)
transcribe_text_v1.description: The original v1 text-to-speech endpoint: convert text to speech with a single provider voice name such as en-US-JennyNeural. Prefer create_audio, which uses the current v8 API and voice ids from list_voices.

texts.description: The text to speak, as one or more paragraphs.

output.description: The result with a link to, or the content of, the generated audio.
